title: 2065. Maximum Path Quality of a Graph

One possible path is 0 -> 1 -> 3 -> 1 -> 0. The total time taken is 10 + 13 + 13 + 10 = 46 <= 50. The nodes visited are 0, 1, and 3, giving a maximal path quality of 1 + 2 + 4 = 7.
